title: Breakout into the Wilderness
description: Evade the night sentries patrolling the outer yard, unlock the Northern Stockade Gate, and break free into the western wilderness.

objectives.description: Slip past the colonial askari sentries patrolling the perimeter fence.
Unlock and breach the Northern Stockade Gate into the western wilderness.

reward_text: Mekatilili and Wanje have escaped from Kisii Prison! The thousand-kilometer walk begins.
